Akshay knows his stuff, from form corrections to intelligent programming, but what makes him invaluable is his patience and consistency. He’ll call you out if you skip, but never to shame you. His point is always clear: showing up matters, but persistence is what leads to growth. That mindset has kept me going when I might’ve quit.
